VSETT (ZOOM) Hydraulic Brake Set The ZOOM E-brake hydraulic system is a high-end braking system that offers more braking power, is more durable, faster/reliable, and provides predictable pad retraction when releasing the brakes. It is virtually maintenance-free (except for worn pads). Standard brake systems require frequent maintenance – eliminate all that by upgrading to hydraulic brakes! Since the hydraulic system is sealed, no dirt can enter and block the moving parts, making them virtually maintenance-free (replacing worn pads is almost all that needs to be done)! Hydraulic systems are also easier to set up and adjust. What Exactly is a Hydraulic Brake and How Does It Differ from the Standard Mechanical Disc Brake? Standard mechanical brakes use a cable to actuate the brakes, and just like derailleur cables, they can stretch and get dirty, affecting braking performance. Mechanical brakes also do not hold up as well as hydraulic brakes. Hydraulic brakes use brake fluid, and when you press the brake lever, the fluid is compressed, and the brakes engage. Larger custom discs are also used, which are more resistant to warping. This method provides stronger and more reliable braking performance. Since hydraulic brakes are a closed system, you don't have to worry about dirt and mud affecting your performance unless you contaminate your pads, but this also applies to mechanical brakes. Kit de Freins Hydrauliques VSETT (ZOOM) Le système de frein hydraulique ZOOM E-brake est un système de freinage haut de gamme qui offre plus de puissance de freinage, est plus durable, plus rapide/fiable, et fournit une rétraction prévisible des plaquettes lors du relâchement des freins. Il est pratiquement sans entretien (à l'exception des plaquettes usées). Les systèmes de freinage standard nécessitent un entretien fréquent – éliminez tout cela en passant aux freins hydrauliques ! Puisque le système hydraulique est scellé, aucune saleté ne peut entrer et bloquer les pièces mobiles, les rendant pratiquement sans entretien (remplacer les plaquettes usées est presque tout ce qui doit être fait) ! Les systèmes hydrauliques sont également plus faciles à installer et à ajuster. Qu'est-ce qu'un Frein Hydraulique et en quoi Diffère-t-il du Frein à Disque Mécanique Standard ? Les freins mécaniques standard utilisent un câble pour actionner les freins, ils peuvent s'étirer et se salir, affectant la performance de freinage. Les freins mécaniques ne résistent pas aussi bien que les freins hydrauliques, et certaines personnes ont même des problèmes de câbles qui cassent sur les freins mécaniques. Les freins hydrauliques utilisent du liquide de frein, et lorsque vous pressez le levier de frein, le liquide est comprimé et les freins s'engagent. Des disques personnalisés plus grands sont également utilisés, qui sont plus résistants à la déformation. Cette méthode offre une performance de freinage plus forte et plus fiable. Comme les freins hydrauliques sont un système fermé, vous n'avez pas à vous soucier de la saleté et de la boue affectant votre performance, sauf si vous contaminez vos plaquettes, mais cela s'applique également aux freins mécaniques. OKO Magic Milk Tubeless Pro 250 ml – Sealant for E-Scooters, E-Bikes & Bicycles OKO Magic Milk Tubeless Pro 250 ml is a high-quality tyre sealant for e-scooters, e-bikes, bicycles, mountain bikes and other tyres. It is designed to seal small punctures and holes quickly and reliably – ideal for daily commuting, leisure rides and sporty use. The sealant is primarily designed for tubeless tyres . However, it can also be used with tyres that have an inner tube , provided that the valve core can be removed and the sealant can be filled directly into the tube. OKO Magic Milk Tubeless Pro seals holes up to 8 mm and spreads evenly inside the tyre. This helps reduce the risk of punctures and makes every ride safer and more comfortable. Especially with e-scooters and e-bikes , reliable puncture protection is important because tyre or inner tube replacement can often be more difficult than on standard bicycles. The sealant is long-lasting, does not clump and does not clog the valve. Depending on use and conditions, it remains active for approx. 6 to 9 months and can then simply be topped up. It is ammonia-free, anti-allergenic, tyre- and rim-friendly, and suitable for use with CO2 cartridges.
